<<A WORD ABOUT MAPPING A SMALL ORCHARD>>  

MAP A SMALL ORCHARD FOR A NEIGHBORHOOD NEWSLETTER.  

THE ORCHARD IS LOCATED IN THE CENTER OF THE NEIGHBORHOOD, NEAR THE HIGHWAY. IT CONSISTS OF A MIX OF APPLE, BERRY, AND GRAPE VARIETIES. THE LAND IS FERTILE AND THE SOIL IS LOAMY.  

THE MAP SHOWS THE LOCATION OF EACH TREE, INCLUDING THE SIZE AND TYPE OF FRUIT. IT ALSO INCLUDES A NOTE ON THE BEST TIME TO PICK EACH FRUIT AND THE LOCATION OF THE ORCHARD FOR TRUCK ACCESS.  

THIS MAP WILL HELP NEIGHBORS TO IDENTIFY THE ORCHARD AND TO PLAN VISITS OR FARMERS MARKET VISITS. THE MAP IS UPDATED ANNUALLY AND IS SHARED WITH ALL NEIGHBORS.  

THE MAP ALSO INCLUDES A KEY THAT EXPLAINS THE SYMBOLS USED AND A NOTE ON THE ORCHARD’S HISTORY AND FARMERS’ NOTES.  

THE ORCHARD IS A COMMUNITY RESOURCE THAT ENHANCES NEIGHBORHOOD CONNECTIONS AND SUPPORTS LOCAL ECONOMY.  

THE MAP IS AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD ON THE NEIGHBORHOOD’S WEBSITE AND CAN BE PRINTED FOR PERSONAL USE.  

THIS PROJECT IS A TEST OF COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT AND A STEP TOWARD MORE INCLUSIVE LAND USE PLANNING.  

[contact person] CAN BE REACHED AT [phone number] FOR QUESTIONS OR COMMENTS.  

[paint color] OF THE MAP SHEET IS SELECTED TO PROMOTE A FRESH AND EASY TO READ LOOK.  

[shelf letter] IS USED TO IDENTIFY THE MAP IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD LIBRARY.  

[map sheet] IS PRINTED ON HIGH-QUALITY PAPER FOR LONG-LASTING USE.
